subject: Onramp pilot: proposed success metrics & milestones
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@helioshealth.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onramp pilot: proposed success metrics & milestones

Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I captured a lean onramp that lets Helios validate latency/cost and integration fit within a 4-week pilot. High-level: 

- Goal: demonstrate parity for two representative workflows (chart summarization and coding-assist for clinician notes) at <= 200ms p50 inference latency and average token cost below $0.0009 for standard prompts.
- Scope: 2 endpoints (summarize, code-assist), up to 10k tokens/day test load, synthetic + 3 real prompt sets you provide.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) Functional: >= 95% pass rate on checklist items (accuracy, hallucination checks per your sample prompts).
  2) Perf: p50 latency <= 200ms, p95 <= 450ms under expected concurrency.
  3) Cost: measured unit token cost <= $0.0009 for chosen model/quant profile.
  4) Ops: end-to-end deployment with RBAC, audit logs, and KV prefix cache working for live inference.

Proposed milestones (week-by-week):
- Week 0 (kickoff): legal + SOW sign, data access checklist, credentials staged.
- Week 1: integration & baseline runs (connect sandbox, run 3 baseline prompts).
- Week 2: performance tuning (batching, quant profiles) and accuracy checks.
- Week 3: final validation + readout prep; customer QA.
- Week 4: readout and decision (go/no-go + next steps).

I've attached a concise POC_Onramp_Plan_v2.pdf with owners (you asked for clear RACI) and an SOW-summary.xlsx for procurement. Can you confirm: 1) the three prompt sets you'll provide (anonymized is fine), 2) a recommended kickoff date the week of Dec 7, and 3) who on your side should receive the DocuSign SOW link?

Thanks — I left Ben and Marissa on cc to help with scheduling and the technical runbook.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Priya — this looks great and aligns with what we need. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Prompt sets: we'll deliver three anonymized prompt bundles by EOD Friday (clinical summaries, administrative note edits, and a handful of edge-case prompts). Lisa will drop those into the shared Drive folder.
2) Success metric tweak: for functional accuracy we prefer a tiered pass (critical items must be 99%+, non-critical 90%+). Is that feasible?
3) Kickoff: Dec 8 preferred for the kickoff session. Procurement wants the SOW routed to procurement@helioshealth.com and cc Lisa.

Also, two asks for the trial: 
- Can we include a short step in Week 2 to capture sample model outputs for our compliance team (redaction support + audit log snippets)?
- If the readout shows a single break/failure type, will you provide a small remediation sprint estimate?

I'll sign off once we have the DocuSign link. Thanks for the clear owners — excited to get started.

— Sam
